title: GroundedResponse
description: Required output structure for every answer generated by the Day 3 grounded generation pipeline. Every field is mandatory. The model must be instructed (via the system prompt) to return exactly this shape.

recommendation.description: A short, direct answer to the clinical question in plain language. Must contain no claim that isn't supported by the evidence/citations below.

evidence.description: A concise, explanatory summary of the retrieved evidence supporting the recommendation, strictly grounded in the retrieved text. Empty only when confidence is 'insufficient' (a refusal).

confidence.description: high: strong direct match in retrieved text. medium: partial/indirect match. low: weak or conflicting match. insufficient: below retrieval confidence threshold — recommendation must then be a refusal message, not a guess.

examples.recommendation: For adults with hypertension who need medication, start with a thiazide-type diuretic, an ACE inhibitor or ARB, or a long-acting calcium channel blocker.
examples.evidence: WHO recommends the use of drugs from any of the following three classes of pharmacological antihypertensive medications as an initial treatment: (1) thiazide and thiazide-like agents; (2) angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitors (ACEis)/angiotensin-receptor blockers (ARBs); (3) long-acting dihydropyridine calcium channel blockers (CCBs).
